-- script --
start /work

type /other/re
snapshot absolute
press enter
state chosen /other/result.txt
press ctrl+u
type ../other/
snapshot relative-parent
press enter
state chosen /other/result.txt
press ctrl+u
type project/no-match
snapshot missing
press ctrl+u
type project/
press backspace
state filter /work/
reads /work 1
press tab
reads /work/project 1
